messages:
maria: FYI infra autoscaler is failing to attach new GPU nodes in eu-west after the CU12 image rebuild. New nodes boot but never appear Ready, pods backfill to older pools :thinking_face:
kira: seeing the same in staging-canary. kubelet logs show: 'error loading kernel modules: version magic mismatch' then container restarts.
juan: suspecting gcc/runtime mismatch — the images were rebuilt with system gcc 13 but nodes still have kernel modules compiled against GCC 11.
maria: good call. stack trace excerpt from one node: `modprobe nvidia_uvm: Unknown symbol in module` and dmesg has `nvidia: disagrees about version of symbol module_layout`.
dana: that’s classic toolchain ABI/rtld mismatch. Did the CI rebuild the toolkit container with a newer libstdc++?
maria: CI used the new base image `redwood/toolkit:cu12-gcc13-2026-03` — we rolled that to eu-west at 03:10 UTC.
sre-oncall: deploy-bot reports: `rolling-update finished` but infra-bot shows many nodes in `NotReady` with reason `KernelModuleProbeFailure`.
juan: temporary mitigation: can we force the autoscaler to skip eu-west and drain new nodes, route traffic to us-west and eu-central? We don’t have enough spare capacity but should avoid churn.
kira: opened a canary pool using the older toolkit image `redwood/toolkit:cu12-gcc11-locked` and re-routed new jobs there. CPU/GPU pressure spiked but no OOMs yet.
maria: patch idea: rebuild the container but compile nvidia modules with the host's gcc via DKMS or match GCC ABI. Short term, add a node bootstrap hook to install the same GCC used in the image.
dana: alternative quick fix: create symlink fallback for libstdc++ versions? risky. Also NCCL hangs observed when mixed runtime libs are present — must avoid half-matched stacks.
juan: logs from a hanging worker: `ncclCommInitRank failed : unhandled error` followed by `invalid ELF header` on `/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libstdc++.so.6`.
maria: created ticket INFRA-4321 and PR #2802 to pin toolkit build to GCC11 for the next 24h; also adding a preflight check in the node image: `modinfo nvidia | grep -q "GCC:.*11" || exit 1`.
sre-oncall: rolling back the eu-west rollout now. Autoscaler will re-attach older nodes. Notifying infra on-call and customers impacted in the EU dev orgs.
deploy-bot: Rollback started for `toolkit-cu12` in eu-west by maria. ETA 12m. :rotating_light:
infra-bot: Canary nodes provisioned with `toolkit:cu12-gcc11-locked` in eu-west-2a. 3/5 GPUs available.
kira: cost note — extra capacity + double images will spike monthly GPU spend. Tagging finance with estimate in INFRA-4321.
juan: long-term: we need a toolchain matrix test in CI that builds kernel modules against multiple distro kernels and GCC versions before any fleet rollout.
maria: agreed. action items: (1) revert rollout (in progress), (2) rebuild toolkit pinned to GCC11 and push canary, (3) add preflight probe to node boot, (4) add CI matrix ticket. I'll update INFRA-4321 with owners.
dana: ping @sre-oncall to validate NCCL layer after rollback. Also schedule a maintenance window for a clean, coordinated toolchain migration.
sre-oncall: acknowledged. monitoring alert rule created for `KernelModuleProbeFailure` and `NCCL_comm_errors` during the window.
maria: thanks all. Will post follow-ups in #eng-infra and notify product if EU customers see latency increases. :white_check_mark:
kira: small note — if anyone needs the quick grep to find mismatched ELFs: `readelf -h /path/to/lib | grep Class; strings /path/to/lib | grep CXXABI` — saved my Sunday once.
juan: saving logs to s3://redwood-ops/INFRA-4321/ for postmortem.
maria: ending thread, will update last_message_ts when rollback completes.
